text.p: Tropical Cyclone Drena is located in the Coral Sea near 19s/161e. Drena is a dangerous storm with maximum sustained winds of 120 mph. Gradual weakening is expected over the next 48 hours as the system tracks southeastward. Drena will track just southwest of New Caledonia paralleling the southwest coast. Locally heavy rains and a very heavy surf are expected along the coast. This system will continue to threaten shipping throughout the forecast period.

Tropical Cyclone Rachel, with 85 mph is tracking southeastward toward the northwest coast of Australia. Landfall is expected within 12 hours somewhere near Dampier. Heavy rains, flash flooding, and a powerful coastal storm surge are expected with Rachel. This storm will weaken over land this period before re-emerging in the Indian Ocean by 72 hours and possibly reintensifying.

Tropical Cyclone Fabriola with 40 mph winds is moving south through the Mozambique Channel. This motion and intensity is expected to continue for the next few days. Fabriola will continue to be a threat to shipping interests over the next 48 hours.
